US.description: Includes federal income tax, FICA (Social Security and Medicare), New York State income tax, and New York City local income tax.

IN.description: Effective tax rate includes income tax based on applicable slabs, surcharge (if income exceeds a certain threshold), and health & education cess. Rate is an approximation for an $85k USD earner choosing an optimal tax regime.

SG.description: Effective income tax rate based on progressive Singapore tax brackets for an equivalent S$114,750 annual income.

CH.description: Effective rate includes federal, cantonal, and municipal income taxes, plus social security contributions, varying significantly by canton and municipality.

NL.description: Includes income tax (Box 1) and mandatory national insurance contributions, after applying general and labor tax credits for a single earner.

GB.description: Effective tax rate includes income tax and National Insurance contributions, calculated based on April 2024 UK rates for an individual earner.

CA.description: Includes federal and provincial income taxes, Canada Pension Plan (CPP) contributions, and Employment Insurance (EI) premiums.

AE.description: The UAE has no personal income tax for expatriates. Social security contributions apply only to UAE nationals.

NO.description: Includes income tax, National Insurance contributions, and progressive top tax (trinnskatt).

IE.description: Includes Income Tax (PAYE), Universal Social Charge (USC), and Pay Related Social Insurance (PRSI) for a single earner.

LU.description: Includes progressive income tax and mandatory social security contributions.

AU.description: Includes federal income tax and Medicare levy.

QA.description: Qatar does not impose personal income tax on salaries and wages for individuals.

BN.description: Brunei Darussalam does not levy personal income tax on its residents or citizens, resulting in an effective tax rate of 0% for an $85k USD earner.

MO.description: Includes personal income tax only, calculated for an $85k USD earner with Macao's progressive tax rates and allowances; no sales tax or capital gains tax.
